integrity: Algebraic proof based on the classical Kummer theorem plus a new digitwise interval covering argument; finite exact-arithmetic verifier supplied as corroboration. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to maximal consecutive nondivisible intervals in a single ordinary Pascal row and prime-power moduli. It does not enumerate all maximal intervals, give all coefficient residues, or treat multinomial coefficients. Historical priority beyond examined sources is unresolved.
title: Sharp longest nondivisibility runs in Pascal rows modulo prime powers
